findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: document.extract_text, document.check_claims, bundle.verify, collection.ask, url.extract, url.summarize, url.qa, url.translate, job.status · Private data: document.extract_text, document.extract_tables, document.parse_invoice, document.check_claims, document.extract_structured, document.summarize, bundle.verify, collection.create, collection.search, collection.ask, url.extract, url.qa, bundle.get, bundle.notarize, receipt.verify, receipt.list, collection.list, collection.add_document, account.quota · Public sink: url.summarize, job.status · Destructive: document.extract_tables, document.extract_structured.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: document.extract_text, document.check_claims, bundle.verify, collection.ask, url.extract, url.summarize, url.qa, url.translate, job.status · Private data: document.extract_text, document.extract_tables, document.parse_invoice, document.check_claims, document.extract_structured, document.summarize, bundle.verify, collection.create, collection.search, collection.ask, url.extract, url.qa, bundle.get, bundle.notarize, receipt.verify, receipt.list, collection.list, collection.add_document, account.quota · Public sink: url.summarize, job.status · Destructive: document.extract_tables, document.extract_structured

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
